text: Sofya City
Lefina
Pelulu
Filecia
Adonius
Oh, it's you two.
Huh?\nWait, you two are together too?
Yes...\nWe're together for a little mission this time.
A little mission?
Finally making normal sweets?
Finally giving up on making sweets?
A-are you...\nFinally gonna make normal sweets?
What do you mean, "normal"...?\nWell, I must admit my sweets may have been a\nlittle too exquisite for ordinary people.
Well, it's true that we'll be making sweets this\ntime...\nBut as she said, that's not our only mission.
Oh~, so you're finally giving up on making\nhazardous stuff you call "sweets"?
What's that supposed to mean...!?
Alright, calm down, Lefina. Let me explain it to\nthem...
Remember that time she and I made monsters out of\nsweets...?
If I'm not mistaken, one was a huge bird, and the\nother was like some kind of beast.
Yes, that's right...\nWe might have to fight bad guys like Libarza or\nsome evil organizations again someday...
To prepare for that, I've decided to create a new\nmasterpiece and let Filecia help me with it!
...Yes, this was all Lefina's idea...I agreed to\nhelp cuz it's always so fun...I mean, cuz I think\nit's essential that we enhance our strength.
As a member of the Besk family, I refuse to sit\nback and just wait for the enemy to come.\nPlaying defense is not my style.
That's right...!\nAs the saying goes, the best defense is a good\noffense...
Well, we'll make normal sweets too.\nIf nothing out of the ordinary happens, we intend\nto hand them out to the people in town.
So, we would like you to gather the ingredients\nfor the sweets...
Welp~, since Filecia is here too, it should be\nfine.\nAlright, off we go then.
I couldn't hear them clearly, but I think I heard\nthem say "monsters", "offense", and "masterpiece".\nThose aren't words you usually hear when baking.
Master Libarza told me to grab whatever they're\nmaking and bring it to him...I guess I have no\nchoice. I'll watch them a little longer.
Oh, you've gathered the ingredients.\nThank you.
Sorry to keep you waiting, Lefina...
What took you so long, Filecia?\nW-well, it's okay. I've already prepped some of\nthe ingredients while waiting for you...
Really...?\nAll right, since it'd be inappropriate to test\nthe sweets here, let's head to the outskirts...
U-uh, alright then, I guess we'll take our leave\nnow...
...Oh...you mean you don't want your reward\nanymore?
Of course I do!! No way I'm working for free!\nUgh~, fine. We just need to go with you to test\nthe sweets, right?!
All right, shall we head out now?\nJust in case, please go first and find us a quiet\nplace.
Lefina...
W-what is it now?!\nOkay, it's a fact that I made a little change to\nthe ingredients, and I kinda feel bad about it!
Well, I could scold you for that, but that new\ncreation actually caught my attention. Maybe we\ncan make it even stronger...
Y-you're right!\nI guess you could call this part of our plan to\nenhance our strength!
A-anyway, thank you very much for helping us with\nthe test. Here's a little something as a token of\nmy gratitude...
All right, let's prepare the sweets for the people\nin town together before they hear about the chaos\nwe caused out there...
Y-you're right!\nI'll help then!
